messages.subject: Error in semPower.Mediation
parts:
My professor recommended I reach out to this group for help. I have been running semPower.Mediation for several days doing a comparison to M+ on sample size estimation. This morning the code just stopped working and gave the error below. I'll post the full code I'm running below that. Any help is appreciated!

Steve

Error in semPower.powerMediation(type = "a-priori", Beta = Beta, indirect = list(c(2,  :

  could not find function "semPower.powerMediation"

Execution halted


Complete code:

Beta <- matrix(c(
  #   X    M    Y
  c(.00, .00, .00),    # X
  c(.40, .00, .00),    # M
  c(.40, .40, .00)     # Y
), byrow = TRUE, ncol = 3)
powerMed <- semPower.powerMediation(type = 'a-priori',
   Beta = Beta,
   indirect = list(c(2, 1), c(3, 2)),
   nIndicator = c(3, 3, 3),
   loadM = c(.65, .65, .65),
   alpha = .05, beta = .20,simulatedPower=TRUE)

names(powerMed)
powerMed$simRes
powerMed$requiredN

messages.author: f1530326ce101401
messages.subject: Re: Error in semPower.Mediation
parts:
Hello,

Just to be sure, did you load the package (i.e., use library(semPower)) before using the function? Usually, a  'could not find function ...' error points towards that.

Best wishes,

Jasper

parts:
Thanks, yes, I loaded the package:

install_packages <- packages[!sapply(packages, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(install_packages) > 0) {
install.packages(install_packages)
}
library(lavaan)
library(semPower)
library(semTools)


 A team-mate re-wrote the code (no changes, just wrote it in a fresh instance) and it seems to have resolved the problem....very strange.

Steve
